kozos_akcio_head: Combined sweep: police and counter-terror units comb the city together
kozos_akcio_body: Reserves from every precinct were called in and SWAT teams stand on the streets. Anyone pulling a job now ends up behind bars fast — and everyone's wanted level just jumped.
kozos_akcio_end: The joint operation is over, the SWAT teams have pulled back.
rendor_korrupcio_head: Exposed: half the precinct is on the mob's payroll
rendor_korrupcio_body: Internal affairs says half the district's officers take envelopes. Silence is cheap right now and arrests are rare.
rendor_korrupcio_end: The corrupt precinct's leadership was replaced, the envelopes dried up.
dronok_head: Drone swarm over the city: thermal cameras watch every street
dronok_body: The new surveillance drones circle day and night. Street robbery and car theft are now a suicidal business.
dronok_end: The drones ran out of battery — the fleet went in for service.
rendor_bal_head: Police ball at the palace: the entire top brass is sipping champagne
rendor_bal_body: Captains, detectives and half the patrol force are dancing tonight. The city is practically unguarded — big targets included.
rendor_bal_end: The ball is over, the hungover officers are back on duty.
arcfelismeres_head: Facial recognition cameras on every corner — the system identifies everyone
arcfelismeres_body: City hall quietly switched the new system on. Heat builds faster after every job and pickpockets get caught within minutes.
arcfelismeres_end: A privacy lawsuit forced the facial recognition offline.
leleplezett_akta_head: Case files vanished — the police start from scratch
leleplezett_akta_body: A server crash (or a well-paid IT guy) wiped half the database. Everyone's wanted level dropped instantly.
leleplezett_akta_end: The database was restored — detectives are back in the picture.
interpol_head: Interpol has arrived: they're hunting international crews
interpol_body: Foreign investigators follow the money. Crew heists are risky and offshore accounts are on fire.
interpol_end: The Interpol agents flew home, the case is closed.
koztarsasagi_ores_head: Armed guards deployed to banks and casinos
koztarsasagi_ores_body: Because of a terror threat, soldiers stand in front of the vaults. Better forget the big targets for now.
koztarsasagi_ores_end: The soldiers left, vault security is back to normal.
bortonlazadas_head: Riot at the penitentiary: the inmates have taken over
bortonlazadas_body: The guards fled and some gates stand open. Anyone with a short sentence walked free — but the police are on edge.
bortonlazadas_end: The riot was put down, the penitentiary is locked again.
tulzsufolt_borton_head: No more room in the cells — courts go easy
tulzsufolt_borton_body: Prisons run at double capacity, so judges are forced to hand down shorter sentences. Bail is cheaper too.
tulzsufolt_borton_end: A new prison wing opened, the leniency is over.
statarium_head: Martial law declared: fast-track trials, harsh sentences
statarium_body: The government declared a state of emergency against crime. Getting caught is expensive now: longer sentences, double bail.
statarium_end: Martial law was lifted, the courts are back to normal procedure.
megvett_ugyesz_head: The chief prosecutor turned out to be the mob's man
megvett_ugyesz_body: The prosecution keeps dropping cases, fines and bail cost half as much. Until it's exposed, criminals are cashing in.
megvett_ugyesz_end: The bought prosecutor got caught — a new prosecution office was set up.
tanuvedelmi_head: New crown-witness program: crew members rat each other out
tanuvedelmi_body: Talk and you walk — and plenty are talking. Look twice at who's standing next to you before a crew job.
tanuvedelmi_end: The witness program ended, the confessions dried up.
szokes_head: Mass breakout: dozens vanished through a tunnel
szokes_body: Someone dug under the prison for weeks. Many got out, but the police are now checking everyone twice.
szokes_end: Most of the escapees were caught, the manhunt is over.
birosagi_sztrajk_head: Court staff on strike — justice grinds to a halt
birosagi_sztrajk_body: Nobody is there to issue fines and cases gather dust. Punishments are lighter for now.
birosagi_sztrajk_end: Court staff reached a deal, hearings resume.
kartell_haboru_head: Cartel war erupts: two families fight for the city
kartell_haboru_body: Shootouts at the docks, warehouses blown up. Risk-takers can make a killing now — but the police are everywhere too.
kartell_haboru_end: Ceasefire: the two families carved up the city.
kokain_hajo_head: The South American shipment landed — money pours into the underworld
kokain_hajo_body: A freighter was unloaded unnoticed at the docks. Everything sells higher on the black market and laundries work cheaper.
kokain_hajo_end: The shipment is gone, the market has calmed down.
dizajnerdrog_head: New designer drug sweeps the clubs — pharma firms panic
dizajnerdrog_body: A pill called "Orange" is everywhere. The money is big, but the police watch anyone moving around the clubs.
dizajnerdrog_end: The new drug was banned and seized, the craze is over.
lefoglalt_szallitmany_head: Customs seized the biggest smuggling shipment ever
lefoglalt_szallitmany_body: Tons of goods vanished from the black market and fences pay pennies. Loot is worth less right now.
lefoglalt_szallitmany_end: A new smuggling route opened, goods are back on the market.
fegyverraktar_head: The military depot was robbed — guns flood the streets
fegyverraktar_body: Crates of rifles hit the black market. Crews are armed up, robberies and armed jobs go easier.
fegyverraktar_end: Most of the weapons were recovered, the market dried up.
kartellfonok_bukott_head: The city's godfather was arrested — the throne is empty
kartellfonok_bukott_body: The head of the biggest family is behind bars and his empire is falling apart. Whoever moves fast now can grab a big slice.
kartellfonok_bukott_end: A new godfather took the throne, order is restored.
csempeszalagut_head: A smuggling tunnel was found under the central bank's depot
csempeszalagut_body: Someone dug it long ago and forgot about it. Whoever knows the entrance can reach the gold bars too.
csempeszalagut_end: The tunnel was filled with concrete.
maffia_adoszedo_head: The family is collecting protection money from everyone
maffia_adoszedo_body: The godfather's men want a cut of every job and laundries cost more too. Less stays in your pocket.
maffia_adoszedo_end: The family dropped the protection money — for now.
bankrendszer_hiba_head: The banks' system crashed — the alarms are down
bankrendszer_hiba_body: A faulty update crippled the banks' security systems. The vaults are vulnerable and bank stocks are tanking.
bankrendszer_hiba_end: The banking system is back, the alarms are armed again.
zsarolovirus_hullam_body: Hackers demand ransom in bitcoin and the money trail disappears in the network. Tech stocks are falling.
zsarolovirus_hullam_end: The ransomware was cracked, companies are back online.
kartyaklonozas_head: Card-skimming gang: every terminal is infected
kartyaklonozas_body: Shop card readers were swapped for fake ones. Mugging members pays far more right now.
kriptokevero_head: A new crypto mixer launched — the money trail vanishes
kriptokevero_body: An anonymous service washes any amount clean through bitcoin, cheaply and without a trace.
darkweb_lekapcsolas_head: The biggest darknet market was taken down
darkweb_lekapcsolas_body: The FBI and local authorities seized the servers together. Loot is hard to sell, laundering is dangerous and crypto is falling.
darkweb_lekapcsolas_end: A new darknet market opened in its place.
hamis_penz_body: A print shop runs day and night. More loot, but if you get caught, the fines are bigger too.
hamis_penz_end: The counterfeit print shop was seized.
adathalasz_banda_head: A phishing gang emptied half the city's accounts
adathalasz_banda_body: Fake texts and calls: the unsuspecting gave up their passwords. Mugging members pays better now.
adathalasz_banda_end: The phishing gang's leaders were arrested.
muzeum_kiallitas_head: Crown jewels at the museum — priceless treasure in the cases
muzeum_kiallitas_body: The crown jewels came to town for a week. Jewelry store and safe loot is multiplied right now.
muzeum_kiallitas_end: The crown jewels were shipped back.
oligarcha_jacht_head: An oligarch's yacht docked — full of jewels and cash
oligarcha_jacht_body: Champagne parties, guests dripping with diamonds. Jewels and casino chips are worth gold right now.
oligarcha_jacht_end: The yacht has left the harbour.
kaszino_vip_est_head: Billionaire VIP night at the Diamond Casino
kaszino_vip_est_body: The world's richest gamblers are at the tables. The casino vault is packed and chip laundering is cheap.
kaszino_vip_est_end: The VIP night is over, the vault is empty.
kaszino_ellenorzes_body: Every chip is tracked, casino laundering is deadly right now and a break-in is almost hopeless.
arany_aremelkedes_head: Gold price at an all-time high
arany_aremelkedes_body: Every bar is worth double now. The gold depot and cash trucks have never paid this well.
arany_aremelkedes_end: The gold price has fallen back.
pancelautok_ujak_head: Next-gen armoured trucks put into service
pancelautok_ujak_body: Cash trucks now drive like tanks. The odds of a crew ambush have halved.
pancelautok_ujak_end: The new trucks turned out faulty — they were withdrawn.
bennfentes_or_head: We have an inside man in the bank's security team
bennfentes_or_body: A bribed guard switches off the cameras and hands over the codes. Now's the time to hit the bank.
bennfentes_or_end: The inside man was caught and fired.
autoszalon_szallitmany_head: Luxury cars arrived at the dealers — keys in the ignition
autoszalon_szallitmany_body: A truckload of sports cars is parked in the dock warehouse. Car theft pays several times more right now.
autoszalon_szallitmany_end: The luxury cars were shipped out.
gps_nyomkovetok_head: Mandatory GPS trackers in every new car
gps_nyomkovetok_body: Insurers fitted trackers everywhere. Car theft is now almost a guaranteed bust.
gps_nyomkovetok_end: Turns out the trackers are easy to jam.
szilveszter_head: New Year's crowd: half the country celebrates downtown
szilveszter_body: Fireworks, champagne, crushing crowds. A golden age for pickpockets — the cops are celebrating too.
szilveszter_end: New Year's is over, the streets were cleaned up.
black_friday_head: Black Friday: crowd brawls in the malls
black_friday_body: Everyone is hunting bargains and the security guards can't keep up. Shoplifting is child's play now.
black_friday_end: The sale is over, the malls are empty.
koncert_head: A global star plays the stadium — a crowd of a hundred thousand
koncert_body: Everyone watches the stage, nobody their pockets. Tonight the crowd belongs to the thieves.
koncert_end: The concert is over, the crowd went home.
viharos_ejszaka_head: Severe storm: lightning and blackouts across the city
viharos_ejszaka_body: The storm knocked out the alarms, but some of the loot gets ruined in the rain too.
viharos_ejszaka_end: The storm passed, the power is back.
suru_kod_head: Milk-white fog has settled over the city
suru_kod_body: You can't see two metres, the cameras are blind. Perfect weather to disappear.
arviz_head: The river burst its banks — evacuated shops, flooded streets
arviz_body: Residents fled and shops are unguarded. The police are busy with rescue, but getting around is hard.
arviz_end: The flood receded, the rebuilding begins.
kijarasi_tilalom_head: Night curfew — anyone on the street is a suspect
kijarasi_tilalom_body: The police check everyone who's out after dark. Hard times for street crime.
gazdag_turistak_body: Expensive watches, fat wallets, naive smiles. Pickpocketing and mugging pay much more right now.
ingatlanbuborek_head: Property fever: everyone's buying, nobody asks questions
ingatlanbuborek_body: Dirty money flows into flats and construction — and comes out clean, cheap and safe.
panama_listak_head: Offshore lists leaked — names, accounts, amounts
panama_listak_body: Journalists published millions of documents. Offshore accounts are traps now and everyone's wanted level went up.
panama_listak_end: The scandal faded, the lists were forgotten.
bankszovetseg_head: The banking association relaxed anti-laundering rules
bankszovetseg_body: New "customer-friendly" rules: fewer questions, fewer reports. Laundering is cheap and safe.
vege_ismeretlen: ⏳ Nobody knows how long it will last
osszeomlas_head: The economy collapsed — there's no money in the underworld either
osszeomlas_body: Everyone is saving, fences pay pennies and laundries are expensive. Every job is worth less right now.
osszeomlas_end: The economy recovered, the black market is busy again.
aranykor_head: Golden age: money pours into the city — and into the underworld
aranykor_body: Wallets are fat, the black market is booming, the banks are full. Now's the time for a big score.
aranykor_end: The golden age is over, the money dried up.
